name: aal-retail-mcp
description: Plain-language education on alternative assets for individual investors: a 351-term glossary, nine learning modules, deep-dive tracks on venture capital and private equity, PE secondaries, tokenized real-world assets, gender-lens investing and Gross Domestic Regeneration, a retirement Monte Carlo estimator, an illiquidity-pacing model, and a lookup of advisors in public SEC and FINRA records. Free previews; full content with a subscription. Educational only, not investment advice.
